structured.answer: I'd pick option ב, the rows: the word and its number sit together on the right, one under the other, so I can read it like a list. In option א I kept losing which number belonged to which column. It told me the keren is worth it, because the employer adds a lot and after 6 years there is no tax, but I'd still ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: Numbers are at the top and labels at the bottom; my eyes lost which number went with which column

stuck.why: English letters (S&P500) and words like מחקה and a ⚠ sign; I didn't know if something was wrong
